name: 5,6-MeO-MiPT
summary: 5,6-MeO-MiPT, also known as 5,6-dimethoxy-N-methyl-N-isopropyltryptamine, is a chemical compound of the tryptamine family. It is the 5,6-dimethoxy derivative of methylisopropyltryptamine (MiPT) and is an analogue of 5-MeO-MiPT. In his 1991 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), Alexander Shulgin listed the dose as greater than 75 mg orally and the duration as unknown.
